entities.summary: Gresi is a Papuan language of Kemtuk Gresi and South Gresi districts in Jayapura Regency, Indonesia. It is very close to Kemtuik. Gresi is spoken in Bring, Hawa, Ibub, Klaysu, Sunna, Tabangkwari, and Yansu villages (Ethnologue).
